Repo owner approval recorded in the ADR (name + date); without it no astro-site-* item may be taken
ADR cross-references dlv2-60, dlv2-62, ci-dedupe-11 and states the ordering constraints
context:
GLOBAL GUARDRAILS (apply to every astro-site-* item):
G-a No change to production deploy wiring until dlv2-62 is done; the site plugs into site-deploy, never into publication-deploy.yml.
G-b docs/ is the single editable content source until the cutover PR. No dual editing.
G-c URL parity: zero URLs from the inventory (astro-site-01) may go missing. Any approved exception needs a static redirect page.
G-d Explorer behaviour is frozen during the migration. Its vitest, jest-axe and Playwright suites stay green; only path and config edits are allowed.
G-e Required checks are never weakened. A new or swapped required context lands in the same PR as its drift guard (AGENTS.md CI policy). The visual gate keeps the ci-dedupe-11 exact-base-SHA semantics.
G-f COMMENT-POLICY-001 applies to TS, Astro and CSS: no explanatory comments or docstrings. Run make comment-policy-check.
G-g No new third-party runtime scripts, analytics or CDN assets; fonts are self-hosted or system. Prism moves off cdnjs.
G-h npm audit:high clean; exact lockfile; check_artifact_privacy.py passes on every assembled artifact.
G-i One PR per item to develop, merged through the queue; no stacked PRs.
G-j Do not commit screenshots or generated binaries.
ABANDON if spike gate G1 fails, or if parity (astro-site-50) cannot reach zero missing URLs without redirects for more than 5% of pages.
description:
Gate G0. No other astro-site-* item may start until this ADR is approved by the repo owner.

Write _project/decisions/adr-astro-unified-site.md. It must decide each of the following, giving the default below or a reasoned alternative:
D1 Package location: `website/` (NOT `site/`, which dlv2-60 reserves for routes.yml and which assemble_public_site.py already uses as its output dir).
D2 Explorer integration: results-explorer stays its own Vite+Preact package served unchanged at /results/ (base `/results/`, DuckDB at /results/data/results.duckdb). The site shares tokens and the header with it. Islands that embed explorer components come only after cutover (astro-site-60).
D3 URL policy: every URL served today keeps resolving at the same path, `.html` suffix included (docs, /blog/YYYY-MM-DD-slug.html, /blog/atom.xml, /_static/, /_images/). Pretty URLs are out of scope.
D4 Content source: docs/ stays the only place content is edited until cutover. The site build converts it at build time; the converted output is committed only in the cutover PR.
D5 Docs versioning follows dlv2-60 routes.yml: /docs/ from the latest release tag and /docs/dev/ from trunk. So production /docs/ moves to Astro only after a release tag contains website/.
D6 Layouts: custom Astro layouts vs Starlight. Left open until spike gate G1 (astro-site-10).
D7 API reference: left open until gate astro-site-02. Docstrings are being deprecated, so generating from docstrings is not an option.
D8 Feed: keep Atom at /blog/atom.xml with unchanged entry ids.
D9 Search: Pagefind, built statically.
D10 Tooling: Node 20 to match CI, an exact lockfile, and no root package.json unless the spike shows workspaces are needed.
D11 Blog drafts: _blog/ stays outside the build.
Also list the global guardrails (see context) and the stop conditions for abandoning the migration.
